them.definition: pron. The objective case of they. See They.

thema.translation: n. 拜占庭帝国的行政区

thematic.definition:
a. relating to or constituting a topic of discourse
a. of or relating to a melodic subject

thematic role.translation: 解元角色, 主题角色（指与动词相关的名词短语的功能, 如施动者或受动者）

thematically.definition: r. with regard to thematic content

thematics.translation: a. 主题的, 主旋律的；题目的；语干的

thematize.translation: vt. 【语音学】变换…为句子主位

thematizes.translation: (thematize 的第三人称 -s形式) vt. 【语音学】变换…为句子主位

thematizing.translation: (thematize 的现在分词) vt. 【语音学】变换…为句子主位

theme.definition:
n. a unifying idea that is a recurrent element in literary or artistic work
n. (music) melodic subject of a musical composition
v. provide with a particular theme or motive
theme.translation: n. 主题, 话题, 题目

theme park.translation: n. （游乐园中的）主题乐园; 主题公园

theme song.translation: 主题歌, 信号曲, 套话

themed.definition: v provide with a particular theme or motive

themes.definition:
n the subject matter of a conversation or discussion
n a unifying idea that is a recurrent element in literary or artistic work
n (music) melodic subject of a musical composition
n an essay (especially one written as an assignment)
n (linguistics) the form of a word after all affixes are removed
v provide with a particular theme or motive
themes.translation: n. 主题（theme的复数）；布景主题；桌面主题

themis.definition: n. (Greek mythology) the Titaness who was goddess of justice in ancient mythology

themistocles.definition: n. Athenian statesman who persuaded Athens to build a navy and then led it to victory over the Persians (527-460 BC)
themistocles.translation: n. 地米斯托克利（古希腊杰出的政治家）

thems.translation: abbr. 泰豪电气管理控制器（Tai Hao electric management controller）

themselves.definition:

   Himself, Herself, Itself.
themselves.translation: pron. 他们自己, 她们自己, 它们自己
